name: Chanel
description:
Made with 100% Brazilian Virgin Remy human hair, she features deep espresso roots that softly blend into a warm chestnut brunette. Fine ribbons of toasted caramel run through the lengths, with brighter pieces around the face. Deeper brown peeks through the caramel, giving her a rich, dimensional blend with a soft transition from root to tip.

All photos are taken in natural lighting. She arrives professionally colored and styled. Care for her as you would your natural hair and touch up the style after unboxing if needed.

All sales are final
